defects.title: Mobile slider pointer/touch mapping is offset at 390px
defects.repro: At 390px viewport, move pointer to 50% of .chart-canvas (354px wide): slider and readout say 'abril de 2023' (index 78). Same fraction at 768 and 1440 gives fevereiro de 2022 (64) and janeiro de 2022 (63). Visible x-axis midpoint is about 2021.
defects.actual: Pointer selection is about 1.5 years later than the point under the cursor at 390. At 390, 75%-87.5% of canvas all select index 118; index 119 appears only at 88% and beyond. At 1440 first/interior/last are exact 0/59/119.
defects.impact: Tooltip/readout and slider do not match the hovered position on the primary mobile width.

defects.title: Touch tap selection fails near the right side and is off by one at first point
defects.repro: 390x844, has_touch. CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent at grid-left+1px, mid 48%, 87.9% (inside the last data point), then 90%. First -> index 1 (novembro de 2016); mid -> index 74 (dezembro de 2022); 87.9% -> remains 74; 90% -> index 119.
defects.actual: Tap on the visible first point selects index 1 instead of 0. Tap at 87.9%, inside the last point, is a no-op; the last period 119 is selected only at 90% and beyond, outside the data point. No page scroll occurred (scrollY 0 throughout).
defects.impact: Tap on the first and last visible points is off by one or does nothing; users must tap beyond the final point to reach the last period.

defects.title: Rich-text tooltip is clipped at 390px
defects.repro: 390px, hover first or midpoint. Tooltip width exceeds 354px canvas; ECharts confine keeps the box inside but the text runs past the right edge.
defects.actual: Observed 'Crédito à habitação - Portugal: 94 907,3 milhões de eur' at first point and '98 689,4 milhões de eur' at midpoint; final 'os' missing. Full value remains in the readout below.
defects.impact: Tooltip cannot be read completely on mobile.

defects.title: CMS preview is not the exact public view: chart JavaScript is absent
defects.repro: Open the existing Juros e crédito preview at 1440. Evaluate DOM: scripts [] (no script tags), .chart-canvas has 0 children, input.chart-range hidden, readout empty. Public page has the bundle, visible range and populated readout.
defects.actual: Preview renders only the static SVG; slider, keyboard interaction and ECharts canvas are missing despite admin copy 'abre a vista pública exata deste rascunho'.
defects.impact: Editors cannot verify the interactive chart before publishing.

defects.title: Horizontal document overflow from footer links on mobile
defects.repro: 390px viewport. document.documentElement.scrollWidth=417 while innerWidth=390. .footer-links bounding width 398.5, right 416.5, white-space nowrap, parent .wrap width 390. At 320, scrollWidth 417.
defects.actual: 27px horizontal overflow at 390 and 97px at 320, caused by footer link row not wrapping; true at all tested public pages.
defects.impact: Mobile page pans horizontally; content width exceeds viewport.

defects.title: CMS editor repeats 1309 series options in every card block
defects.repro: Measured served HTML 835,202 bytes, 17 select elements, 5,356 option elements. Each of block_series_0, block_series_1, block_series_2 and add_series contains 1,309 options. CMS index is 407,253 bytes with 2,652 options.
defects.actual: Four full copies of the 1309-item series list make the editor DOM heavy and each select long to scan.
defects.impact: Slow editor load and poor control usability; repeated options also appear in the add-block form.

defects.title: Duplicate-slug server error is English in Portuguese admin
defects.repro: Submit create form with slug juros-e-credito and valid title/note.
defects.actual: HTTP 422 page shows 'page/juros-e-credito: already exists; duplicate it for a new slug' in an otherwise Portuguese UI. Native required-field validation also appeared in English under the test browser locale.
defects.impact: Error UX is inconsistent and not localized.

defects.title: Left chart margin selects last data point
defects.repro: 1440px, move pointer to 2% of .chart-canvas width (left of ECharts grid, x=0.02).
defects.actual: Slider jumps to index 119 / setembro de 2026 instead of first point or no change. 390px shows same behavior at 2%.
defects.impact: Pointer in empty left padding shows the last period, contradicting position.
